description: Header file defining classes and structures for media capabilities caching and codec capability querying in Android shared environment, including Range, CodecCapability, AudioCodecCapability, VideoCodecCapability, and MediaCapabilitiesCache.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: Represents a numerical range with minimum and maximum values, used for supported widths, heights, bitrates, etc.

classes.name: CodecCapability
classes.description: Base class representing general codec capabilities, including security and tunnel mode support.

classes.name: AudioCodecCapability
classes.description: Derived class for audio codec capabilities, including bitrate support.

classes.name: VideoCodecCapability
classes.description: Derived class for video codec capabilities, including resolution, frame rate, and bitrate support.

classes.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache
classes.description: Singleton class managing media capabilities, decoder support, and configurations.

methods.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache::GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MediaCapabilitiesCache.

methods.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache::IsWidevineSupported
methods.description: Checks if Widevine DRM is supported.

methods.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache::IsCbcsSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if Cbcs scheme is supported.

methods.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache::IsHDRTransferCharacteristicsSupported
methods.description: Checks HDR transfer characteristics support for a given transfer ID.

methods.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache::IsPassthroughSupported
methods.description: Checks if passthrough is supported for a given audio codec.

methods.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache::GetAudioConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves audio configuration at a specified index.

methods.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache::HasAudioDecoderFor
methods.description: Determines if an audio decoder exists for a given MIME type and bitrate.

methods.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache::HasVideoDecoderFor
methods.description: Determines if a video decoder exists for specified parameters.

methods.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache::FindAudioDecoder
methods.description: Finds an audio decoder for a given MIME type and bitrate.

methods.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache::FindVideoDecoder
methods.description: Finds a video decoder for specified parameters.

methods.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache::IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the cache is enabled.
